newsitem.title: FRANCE: France chides Serbia for third day running.
newsitem.headline: France chides Serbia for third day running.

text.p: France, publicly criticising Serbia for the third day in a row, condemned Belgrade on Wednesday for shutting down two independent radio stations and warned against using force to curb street demonstrations.

"We very strongly condemn the closing of the two non-government radio stations," foreign ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt told a news briefing about the closing down of radio stations B-92 and Radio Index.
"We also warn Yugoslav authorities against any use of force (against street demonstrations). The right to information and the right to demonstrate must be respected," Rummelhardt said.

The French foreign ministry, expressing "extreme concern" at the situation, said on Tuesday: "Authorities in Belgrade should expect a severe warning from the international community if they choose the path of direct confrontation."

"They must on the contrary look for opening and dialogue," another ministry spokesman, Yves Doutriaux, said about Belgrade's handling of the crisis sparked by the annulment of opposition victories in municipal polls on November 17 and which led to demonstrations drawing up to 100,000 protesters a day.
